question_text: Do you hold a valid ISO 9001 certificate for the manufacturing site? Attach a copy.
Can you meet the specified bursting strength for every quoted line? Attach a recent (within 6 months) test report.
Do you accept rejection and free replacement of lots failing incoming inspection, at your cost?
Monthly corrugation capacity available for this contract (tonnes/month)?
Lead time for first supply after PO and artwork approval (days)?
Kraft paper source for liners: virgin, recycled, or mixed?
Do you hold FSC chain-of-custody certification? Attach if yes.
Number of quality complaints/rejections from FMCG customers in the last 12 months?
